whenToUse: Screens with few elements, such as the first screen of a landing page.
You want the eye to end on the main action.
whenNotToUse: Text-heavy screens (they're read in an F pattern).
So many elements that the path blurs.

alternatives.name: Hero Section
alternatives.reason: A first screen built around a title and an action.

accessibility: Keep the DOM in the same order as the Z path so the reading and visual order match.
The eye path marks are decorative, so they're aria-hidden.
The main action is a real button and comes last.
Use only grid placement, avoiding absolute positioning, so nothing overlaps when zoomed.
